headline: Kyrgyzstan and Turkmenistan discuss gas pipeline and new transport routes
summary: Kyrgyz parliament speaker Marlen Mamataliev discussed expanding bilateral cooperation with his Turkmen counterpart, including a gas pipeline and new transport routes. No agreement terms were reported.
why: Gas pipelines and transit corridors determine how Central Asian energy and trade flows reach export markets, which affects regional commodity and infrastructure investment.
original_headline: Кыргызстан и Туркменистан обсудили газопровод и новые транспортные маршруты
